title: Comparing Bad Apples to Good Oranges: Aligning Large Language Models via Joint Preference Optimization
authors_zh: Hritik Bansal, Ashima Suvarna, Gantavya Bhatt, Nanyun Peng, Kai-Wei Chang, Aditya Grover（加州大学洛杉矶分校、华盛顿大学）
paper_type_zh: 联合偏好采集与优化目标研究
best_for_zh: 适合设计需要捕捉非同一指令间相对帮助性或任务完成度的偏好数据集的读者。
one_line: JPO learns from comparisons between complete instruction-response pairs, expanding preference optimization beyond fixed-context response rankings.
JPO 从完整的指令—回答对之间学习比较，使偏好优化超出固定上下文下的回答排序。
why: It exposes preference signal that ordinary within-instruction rankings cannot record and makes that signal directly consumable by an alignment objective.
inclusion_reason: It changes the preference record from a same-instruction response pair to a possibly cross-instruction pair and trains directly on that joint comparison.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Ordinary preference datasets compare two answers only after fixing one instruction. This protocol captures which of two alternatives is better for that request, but it cannot express that a response to one request is more helpful, accurate, or useful than a response to a different request. It therefore narrows the set of human judgments that may become alignment data.

JPO asks whether annotators can reliably compare complete instruction-response records across non-identical contexts, and whether a model can learn from those comparisons. It changes the training record itself: the competitor is no longer merely another answer to the same prompt, but another instruction-answer pair. The goal is to broaden what preference acquisition supplies to optimization.

普通偏好数据集只会在固定一条指令后比较两份回答。该协议能够捕捉哪一个替代回答更适合该请求，却不能表达对一个请求的回答比对另一个请求的回答更有帮助、更准确或更有用。因此，它缩小了能够成为对齐数据的人类判断集合。

JPO 询问标注者能否可靠地跨越非同一上下文比较完整的指令—回答记录，以及模型能否从这些比较中学习。它改变训练记录本身：竞争对象不再只是同一提示的另一份回答，而是另一条指令—回答对。目标是扩展偏好采集可供优化使用的内容。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
JPO treats the joint probability of an instruction and its response as the object of preference. Given two records, it upweights the selected joint pair relative to the rejected joint pair. A conventional conditional comparison is retained as the special case in which the two instructions are identical, so one objective can consume both familiar and newly acquired feedback.

This framing enables labels that a fixed-context protocol hides. Two responses that are both rejected within their own prompts can still be judged decisively when placed beside one another, because annotators compare task fulfillment across the complete records. JPO makes such a judgment a valid optimization target instead of discarding it as incomparable.

JPO 将一条指令与其回答的联合概率视为偏好对象。给定两条记录，它提高被选中联合对相对于被拒绝联合对的概率。传统条件比较被保留为两条指令相同的特殊情形，因此一个目标可以同时消费熟悉的和新采集的反馈。

这一表述使固定上下文协议隐藏的标签成为可能。两份在各自提示下都被拒绝的回答，放在一起时仍可以得到明确判断，因为标注者比较的是完整记录之间的任务完成度。JPO 将这类判断变成有效的优化目标，而不是把它当作不可比较而丢弃。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors remove duplicate instructions, randomly select one response from each source instance, and match two different instruction-response records to build a joint comparison dataset. GPT-3.5-Turbo-0125 labels both conditional and joint comparisons twice with reversed order; flipped labels are treated as ties. Human analysis uses qualified Mechanical Turk workers on 2,000 comparisons.

Mistral-7B is first supervised fine-tuned on instruction-response data. JPO then trains on the union of conditional and non-identical joint comparisons, whereas DPO and KTO receive the conditional data. Evaluation compares generated outputs against gold test responses for 500 unseen instructions, averaging three optimization runs and three sampling temperatures; AlpacaEval 2 gives an additional broad instruction test.

作者移除重复指令，从每个源实例随机选择一份回答，并匹配两条不同的指令—回答记录以构建联合比较数据集。GPT-3.5-Turbo-0125 对条件和联合比较都以相反顺序标注两次；标签翻转时被视为平局。人工分析使用通过资格筛选的 Mechanical Turk 工作者，对 2,000 个比较进行标注。

Mistral-7B 首先在指令—回答数据上做监督微调。JPO 随后在条件比较与非同一指令联合比较的并集上训练，而 DPO 和 KTO 接收条件数据。评测把生成输出与 500 条未见指令的金标准回答比较，平均三个优化运行和三个采样温度；AlpacaEval 2 提供额外的广泛指令测试。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Human-human agreement averages 67.5% and human-AI agreement 66.5% across the two ranking protocols, which the authors regard as comparable to prior preference-collection studies. In joint comparisons where both records were either conditionally chosen or conditionally rejected, annotators still made a decisive choice 71% of the time. When one record was conditionally chosen and the other rejected, annotators did not prefer the conditionally chosen record in 48% of comparisons.

On TL;DR and Anthropic Helpful, JPO exceeds DPO by 5.2 and 3.3 win-rate points, respectively, averaged across sampling temperatures. It is 1.8 points higher than DPO on AlpacaEval 2 length-controlled win rate. A JPO model trained only on non-identical joint preferences reaches 71.7% on TL;DR, and a size-matched fifty-fifty joint/conditional mix exceeds DPO by 4.2 points.

在两种排序协议上，人工—人工一致率平均为 67.5%，人工—人工智能一致率为 66.5%，作者认为这与先前偏好收集研究可比。在两条记录都曾被条件协议选中或都曾被拒绝的联合比较中，标注者仍有 71% 的时间做出明确选择。当一条记录在条件协议中被选中、另一条被拒绝时，标注者在 48% 的比较中并不偏好条件协议选中的记录。

在 TL;DR 和 Anthropic Helpful 上，JPO 分别比 DPO 高 5.2 和 3.3 个胜率点，结果在采样温度上取平均。它在 AlpacaEval 2 的长度控制胜率上比 DPO 高 1.8 点。只在非同一指令联合偏好上训练的 JPO 模型在 TL;DR 上达到 71.7%，大小匹配的五五联合/条件混合比 DPO 高 4.2 点。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The novelty begins before the loss: JPO proposes a comparison protocol in which the context may differ on the two sides. This differs from scoring individual outputs as well as from DPO-style conditional rankings. It recognizes that preference can be expressed over the success of complete interactions, not only over response alternatives held under one fixed request.

The objective then makes this acquisition protocol operational by comparing joint instruction-response probabilities. Its unification is useful: conventional preference pairs need not be discarded, because they are the identical-instruction subset of the same formulation. The contribution therefore links a broader human judgment surface to a directly trainable record format.

新意从损失之前开始：JPO 提出一种比较协议，其中两侧的上下文可以不同。这不同于给单个输出评分，也不同于 DPO 风格的条件排序。它承认偏好可以表达为对完整交互成功程度的判断，而不只是在一个固定请求下对回答替代项的判断。

该目标随后通过比较联合指令—回答概率，使这一采集协议可以用于训练。它的统一性很有用：传统偏好回答对不必被丢弃，因为它们是同一表述中指令相同的子集。因此，该贡献把更广的人类判断表面连接到可直接训练的记录格式。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Joint comparisons grow quadratically with the number of available records, making exhaustive collection impractical and leaving informative-pair selection open. The authors also note that either conditional or joint ranking does not identify the particular strengths and weaknesses of a response, and different feedback forms can disagree. Reported alignment evaluation relies substantially on a GPT-3.5 evaluator, while experiments focus on summarization and single-turn helpful dialogue.
联合比较会随可用记录数呈二次增长，使穷尽收集不现实，也使信息量最高的回答对选择仍待解决。作者还指出，无论条件排序还是联合排序，都不能识别回答的具体优势和弱点，不同形式的反馈也可能彼此不一致。报告的对齐评测在很大程度上依赖 GPT-3.5 评估器，实验集中于摘要和单轮有帮助对话。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: JPO is useful when a team wants preference data to reflect holistic task fulfillment across heterogeneous requests, rather than only a local choice between alternative phrasings. It is especially relevant when existing conditional labels are plentiful but leave no way to compare the quality of two separately successful or separately failed interactions. It is less appropriate when annotation cost cannot support pair selection across a larger record pool.
当团队希望偏好数据反映异质请求之间完整的任务完成度，而不只是替代表达之间的局部选择时，JPO 很有用。当已有条件标签很多，却无法比较两次分别成功或分别失败交互的质量时，它尤其相关。当标注成本无法支持在更大记录池中选择回答对时，它不太合适。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the acquisition protocol before the objective: the paper's main change is what an annotator compares. Then use the agreement and interplay analysis to see why the authors regard non-identical contexts as meaningful rather than arbitrary noise. Finally inspect the joint-only and fixed-size ablations, which separate the value of the new comparisons from simply adding more feedback records.
在阅读目标之前先阅读采集协议：论文的主要改变是标注者比较什么。然后使用一致性和交互分析，理解作者为何把非同一上下文视为有意义而非任意噪声。最后检查只使用联合偏好和固定规模的消融，它们将新比较的价值与单纯增加更多反馈记录区分开来。
